_source.claude: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (model pricing table and prompt caching section), fetched 2026-10-09. Cache writes are 1.25x (5m) and 2x (1h) base input; cache reads are 0.1x, except 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 and 0.025x on Fable 5.1.

_notes: USD per million tokens, API list price. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Claude: input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite5m, cacheWrite1h. Optional longContext replaces those rates for a request whose whole prompt (input + cache reads + cache writes) is over longContext.above tokens (Haiku 5.5 only). Optional fastMultiplier applies when a Claude line says speed fast. OpenAI: input, cachedInput, output, and cacheWrite (used only if the log reports cache_write_input_tokens). OpenAI long-context rates (over 272K input tokens in one request) are left out on purpose, since Codex's context window is 258,400 and can't reach them. No price was found for codex-auto-review (used by Codex guardian reviews), so it is left out; usage.mjs lists any unpriced model in "unpriced" and charges it at the highest rate of each token type among the entries of the same log source (Claude entries for Claude logs, gpt-* entries for Codex logs), so keep every model the factory uses in here. Not billed here: web search ($10 per 1,000 searches), US-only inference (1.1x), batch discounts.
